name: Conan: Horde Slayer ⚔️
desc:
The hordes are rising! A sinister power spreads across the realm, twisting beasts and warriors alike into relentless monsters. Stand with Conan the Barbarian and carve your legend in this ferocious co-op wave survival experience. Only the strongest will endure!

⚔️ BATTLE across the savage lands of the Hyborian Age!
🔥 UPGRADE your hero, master new weapons, and grow stronger each run!
🤝 UNITE with allies in co-op multiplayer to survive the onslaught!
🩷 FAVORITE & FOLLOW to stay updated on new events, maps, and gear!
